news.title: Insider recently sold ₹22m worth of stock
news.body: On the 28th of January, Mayank Tandon sold around 122k shares on-market at roughly ₹178 per share. This transaction amounted to 37% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest sale by an insider in the last 3 months. Insiders have been net sellers, collectively disposing of ₹16m more than they bought in the last 12 months.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.26 (vs ₹4.19 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.26 (up from ₹4.19 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹274.7m (up 39% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹26.0m (up ₹59.5m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.5% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 97 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Puretrop Fruits Limited (BSE:530077) announces an Equity Buyback for 1,100,000 shares, representing 13.8% for INR 220 million.
news.body: Puretrop Fruits Limited (BSE:530077) announces a share repurchase program. Under the offer, the company will repurchase up to 1,100,000 shares, representing 13.8% of its issued share capital, for INR 336.88 million. The shares will be repurchased at a price of INR 200 per share. The program is subject to approval of shareholders by way of a special resolution through a postal ballot. As of December 31, 2025, the company had 7,969,902 shares issued and outstanding.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
